<|fim_prefix|>;; Given a sequence of frames, produce a new sequence where each frame is
;; overlaid with the frames a few positions before and after.

(define (overlaid-frame all-frames index)
  (let* ((n (length all-frames))
         (indices (list (max 0 (- index 6))
                        (max 0 (- index 3))
                        index
<|fim_middle|>                        (min (- n 1) (+ index 3))
                        (min (- n 1) (+ index 6))))
         (frames (map (lambda (i) (list-ref all-frames i)) indices))
         (alphas '(0.2 0.4 1.0 0.4 0.2)))
    (world/reset!)
    (for-each
      (lambda (frame alpha)
        (world/place-frame frame :alpha alpha))
<|fim_suffix|>      frames alphas)
    (world/render!)))

(define (overlaid-time-animation frames)
  (transport/fps 24)
  (for-each
    (lambda (i)
      (overlaid-frame frames i)
      (world/wait (/ 1.0 24.0)))
    (range 0 (length frames))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Background gradient: darker at top, lighter at bottom
(define (draw-background)
  (define (paint-row y)
    (let ((brightness (quotient (* y 255) 30)))
      (define (paint-cols x)
        (when (< x 40)
          (paint-cell x y (string-append \"rgb(\" 
                                         (number->string brightness) \",\" 
                                         (number->string brightness) \",\" 
                                         (number->string brightness) \")\"))
          (paint-cols (+ x 1))))
      (paint-cols 0)))
  (define (paint-rows y)
    (when (< y 30)
      (paint-row y)
      (paint-rows (+ y 1))))
<|fim_middle|>  (paint-rows 0))

;; Orbiting yellow dot
(define (draw-orbit)
  (let* ((cx 20)
         (cy 15)
         (r 8)
         (theta (* (frame) 0.05))
         (x (+ cx (* r (cos theta))))
         (y (+ cy (* r (sin theta))))
         (xi (inexact->exact (round x)))
         (yi (inexact->exact (round y))))
    (paint-cell xi yi \"yellow\")))

;; Bouncing red dot (horizontal)
(define (draw-bounce)
<|fim_suffix|>  (let ((x (modulo (frame) 40)))
    (paint-cell x 28 \"red\")))

;; Pulsing green dot (fade in/out via color brightness)
(define (draw-pulse)
  (let* ((cycle (modulo (frame) 120))
         (brightness (if (< cycle 60)
                         (* cycle 4)
                         (* (- 120 cycle) 4)))
         (green-val (min 255 brightness)))
    (paint-cell 20 5 (string-append \"rgb(0,\" (number->string green-val) \",0)\"))))

;; Compose all layers
(draw-background)
(draw-orbit)
(draw-bounce)
(draw-pulse)

    (let loop-plum ((step 0))

        (let crouch ((f 0))

        (let ((strength (- 1.2 (* step 0.1))))

          (entity/accel! plum strength 0)
          (let action ((f 0))

    ;; Run this concurrently by resetting frame counter

    ;; Reset world to start of plum's journey and run cherry separately

    (let loop-cherry ((step 0))

        (entity/accel! cherry 1.5 0)
        (let action ((f 0))

<|fim_prefix|>;; A seeker: a dot that always wants to move toward a target point.
(define (seeker-demo)
  (let* ((w (world/spawn '()))
         (target '(16 12))
         (entity (world/spawn w `((pos (4 4))
                                   (vel (0 0))

        (paint-cell (car pos) (cdr pos) \"🔵\")
<|fim_middle|>        (paint-cell (car target) (cdr target) \"🎯\")))
    
    (define (step)
      (let* ((pos (entity/pos entity))
             (vel (entity/vel entity))
             ;; seek: desired velocity points from pos to target, at max speed
             (dx (- (car target) (car pos)))
             (dy (- (cdr target) (cdr pos)))
             (dist (dsqrt (+ (* dx dx) (* dy dy))))
             (desired (if (> dist 0.01)
                          (cons (* (/ dx dist) 2.0)   ; normalize, scale to max-speed
                                (* (/ dy dist) 2.0))
<|fim_suffix|>                          '(0 . 0)))
             ;; steering force = desired − current
             (steer-x (- (car desired) (car vel)))
             (steer-y (- (cdr desired) (cdr vel))))
        (entity/accel! entity steer-x steer-y)
        (world/step w)))
    
    (big-bang w
              (on-tick step)
              (to-draw draw))))

             (entity/set! eid 'behavior 'wander)
             (entity/set! eid 'target #f)))))))

(define (dragonfly-brain eid frame)
  (let ((behavior (entity/get eid 'behavior))
        (target (entity/get eid 'target))
        (hunger (entity/get-set! eid 'hunger 0)))
<|fim_middle|>    (entity/set! eid 'hunger (+ hunger 1))
    (cond
      ((eq? behavior 'patrol)
       (let* ((patrol (entity/get eid 'patrol))
              (index (entity/get eid 'patrol-index))
              (waypoint (list-ref patrol index))
              (wx (car waypoint))
              (wy (cadr waypoint))
              (dist (entity/distance eid wx wy)))
         (ai/seek eid wx wy)
         (when (< dist 2.0)
           (entity/set! eid 'patrol-index (modulo (+ index 1) (length patrol)))))
       (when (> hunger 300)
         (let ((prey (world/nearest eid 'bee 12.0)))
           (when prey
             (entity/set! eid 'behavior 'chase)
             (entity/set! eid 'target prey)))))
      ((eq? behavior 'chase)
       (if (and target (entity/alive? target))
           (let ((dist (entity/distance eid (entity/x target) (entity/y target))))
             (ai/pursue eid target)
             (when (< dist 1.0)
               (entity/despawn! target)
               (entity/set! eid 'hunger 0)
               (entity/set! eid 'behavior 'patrol)
               (entity/set! eid 'target #f)))
           (begin
             (entity/set! eid 'behavior 'patrol)
             (entity/set! eid 'target #f)))))))

(define (emit-pollen x y)
  (let loop ((i 0))
    (when (< i 5)
      (let ((px (+ x (* (- (random) 0.5) 0.5)))
            (py (+ y (* (- (random) 0.5) 0.5)))
            (vx (* (- (random) 0.5) 0.2))
            (vy (* (- (random) 0.5) 0.2))
            (p (world/spawn px py 'pollen)))
        (entity/set-vel! p vx vy)
        (entity/gravity-scale! p -0.1)
        (entity/max-speed! p 0.5)
        (entity/drag! p 0.95)
        (entity/set! p 'lifetime 120)
        (loop (+ i 1))))))

(define (animate-pollen eid frame)
  (let* ((life (entity/get eid 'lifetime))
         (wind-x (car (world/wind)))
         (wind-y (cadr (world/wind))))
    (entity/accel! eid wind-x wind-y)
    (entity/set! eid 'lifetime (- life 1))
    (when (<= (entity/get eid 'lifetime) 0)
      (entity/despawn! eid))))

;; === ENVIRONMENT ===

(define (day-phase frame)
  (modulo frame 1440))

(define (sky-color phase)
  (cond
    ((< phase 360) '(0.3 0.4 0.6))
    ((< phase 720) '(0.5 0.7 1.0))
    ((< phase 1080) '(0.8 0.5 0.3))
    (else '(0.1 0.1 0.2))))

(define (draw-sky frame)
  (let ((c (sky-color (day-phase frame))))
    (let loop ((x 0))
      (when (< x 40)
        (let row ((y 0))
          (when (< y 2)
            (paint-cell x y c)
            (row (+ y 1))))
        (loop (+ x 1))))))

(define (draw-ground)
  (let loop ((x 0))
    (when (< x 40)
      (let row ((y 2))
        (when (< y 30)
          (let ((c (cond
                     ((< y 20) '(0.4 0.6 0.3))
                     (else '(0.5 0.4 0.3)))))
            (paint-cell x y c))
<|fim_suffix|>          (row (+ y 1))))
      (loop (+ x 1)))))

;; === DIRECTOR ===

(define (director-policy frame)
  (let ((bee-count (group/count 'bee))
        (dragonfly-count (group/count 'dragonfly)))
    (cond
      ((> bee-count 8)
       (when (and (= dragonfly-count 1) (= (modulo frame 600) 0))
         (let ((df (prefab/spawn 'dragonfly 35 5 '((30 5) (10 5) (10 15) (30 15)))))
           (entity/set! df 'is-extra 1)))
       (world/wind! (* 0.08 (dsin (* frame 0.005))) 0))
      ((< bee-count 3)
       (when (> dragonfly-count 1)
         (world/each (lambda (e)
                       (when (and (eq? (entity/kind e) 'dragonfly)
                                  (> (entity/get-set! e 'is-extra 0) 0))
                         (entity/despawn! e)))))
       (world/wind! (* 0.02 (dsin (* frame 0.005))) 0))
      (else
       (world/wind! (* 0.05 (dsin (* frame 0.005))) 0)))))

;; === CAMERA ===

(define (pick-camera-subject)
  (let ((dragonfly (world/find 'dragonfly)))
    (if (and dragonfly (eq? (entity/get dragonfly 'behavior) 'chase))
        (let ((target (entity/get dragonfly 'target)))
          (if target target dragonfly))
        (let ((feeding-bee #f))
          (world/each (lambda (e)
                        (when (and (not feeding-bee)
                                   (eq? (entity/kind e) 'bee)
                                   (eq? (entity/get e 'behavior) 'feed))
                          (set! feeding-bee e))))
          (if feeding-bee feeding-bee dragonfly)))))

(define (update-camera frame)
  (let ((subject (pick-camera-subject)))
    (when subject
      (world/camera-follow! subject 0.05))))

;; === SPAWN ===

(define (spawn-garden)
  (world/reset!)
  (draw-ground)
  (let loop ((i 0))
    (when (< i 20)
      (let ((x (+ 5 (* i 1.5)))
            (y (+ 10 (* (dsin (* i 0.5)) 2)))
            (hue (* i 0.05))
            (phase (* i 0.3)))
        (prefab/spawn 'flower x y hue phase))
      (loop (+ i 1))))
  (let loop ((i 0))
    (when (< i 5)
      (prefab/spawn 'bee (+ 10 (* i 5)) 5)
      (loop (+ i 1))))
  (prefab/spawn 'dragonfly 20 5 '((10 5) (30 5) (30 15) (10 15)))
  (world/wind! 0.02 0))

;; === RUN ===

(spawn-garden)

(big-bang
  (on-tick (lambda (state frame)
             (draw-sky frame)
             (director-policy frame)
             (world/step)
             (update-camera frame)
             (world/each (lambda (e)
                           (cond
                             ((eq? (entity/kind e) 'flower)
                              (animate-flower e frame))
                             ((eq? (entity/kind e) 'bee)
                              (bee-brain e frame))
                             ((eq? (entity/kind e) 'dragonfly)
                              (dragonfly-brain e frame))
                             ((eq? (entity/kind e) 'pollen)
                              (animate-pollen e frame)))))
             state))
  (to-draw (lambda (state) #t)))

<|fim_prefix|>;; A ship you can retune while it flies.
;; 'a' fire; up/down adjust selected knob; left/right change knob.
(define ship-angle 0)
(define rot-vel 0)
(define knob-index 0)
(define knobs (vector 0.01   ; 0: rot-accel
                      0.08   ; 1: rot-max
                      0.85   ; 2: rot-decay
                      0.20   ; 3: thrust-per-frame
                      0.90   ; 4: thrust-decay
                      0.08   ; 5: camera-lag
                      40     ; 6: camera-dead-x
                      30))   ; 7: camera-dead-y
(define knob-names '#(\"rot-acc\" \"rot-max\" \"rot-dec\"
                     \"thr\" \"thr-dec\"
                     \"cam-lag\" \"dead-x\" \"dead-y\"))
(define thrust-charge 0)

(define (tuning-bench)
  (world/reset!)
  (let ((ship (world/spawn 'ship 160 120)))
    (entity/shape! ship 'triangle 12)
<|fim_middle|>    (entity/drag! ship 0.01)
    (on-frame
     (lambda ()
       ;; Knob switching.
       (when (input/pressed? 'left)
         (set! knob-index (max 0 (- knob-index 1))))
       (when (input/pressed? 'right)
         (set! knob-index (min 7 (+ knob-index 1))))
       ;; Knob adjustment.
       (when (input/down? 'up)
         (vector-set! knobs knob-index
                      (+ (vector-ref knobs knob-index)
                         (if (< knob-index 5) 0.001 0.5))))
       (when (input/down? 'down)
         (vector-set! knobs knob-index
                      (- (vector-ref knobs knob-index)
                         (if (< knob-index 5) 0.001 0.5))))
       ;; Rotation using knobs.
       (let ((rot-acc (vector-ref knobs 0))
             (rot-max (vector-ref knobs 1))
             (rot-dec (vector-ref knobs 2))
             (thr     (vector-ref knobs 3))
<|fim_suffix|>             (thr-dec (vector-ref knobs 4))
             (cam-lag (vector-ref knobs 5))
             (dead-x  (vector-ref knobs 6))
             (dead-y  (vector-ref knobs 7)))
         ;; Rotation.
         (cond
           ((input/down? 'a) (set! rot-vel (min rot-max (+ rot-vel rot-acc))))
           ((input/down? 'b) (set! rot-vel (max (- rot-max) (- rot-vel rot-acc))))
           (else (set! rot-vel (* rot-vel rot-dec))))
         (set! ship-angle (+ ship-angle rot-vel))
         ;; Thrust.
         (set! thrust-charge (* thrust-charge thr-dec))
         ;; (no explicit thrust button in this bench — you're tuning rot)
         (world/step)
         (world/camera-follow! ship cam-lag dead-x dead-y)
         (paint-clear)
         (paint-cell 'ship (entity/x ship) (entity/y ship) 12 12)
         (paint-text (string-append (vector-ref knob-names knob-index)
                                    \": \"

<|fim_prefix|>;; A little level design language.
;;   #  ground/wall
;;   .  air (nothing)
;;   P  player start
;;   G  goal

(define level-1
  '(\"..............................\"
    \"..............................\"
    \"..............................\"
    \"..............................\"
    \"..............#####...........\"
    \"..............................\"
    \"........########..............\"
    \"..............................\"
    \"...##...................######\"
    \"..............................\"
    \"P........................#...G\"
    \"##############################\"))

(define (parse-level lines)
  (world/reset!)
  (let ((rows (length lines))
        (player-spawn #f)
        (goal-spawn #f))
    (let loop-r ((row 0))
      (when (< row rows)
        (let ((line (list-ref lines row)))
          (let loop-c ((col 0))
<|fim_middle|>            (when (< col (string-length line))
              (let ((ch (string-ref line col))
                    (x (* col 32))
                    (y (* row 20)))
                (cond
                  ((char=? ch #\\#)
                   (let ((t (world/spawn 'ground x y)))
                     (entity/shape! t 'rect 32 20)
                     (entity/solid! t #t)))
                  ((char=? ch #\\P)
                   (set! player-spawn (list x y)))
                  ((char=? ch #\\G)
                   (set! goal-spawn (list x y))))
                (loop-c (+ col 1)))))
          (loop-r (+ row 1)))))
    (list player-spawn goal-spawn)))

(define (play-level)
  (let* ((spawns (parse-level level-1))
         (player-spawn (car spawns))
         (goal-spawn   (cadr spawns))
         (p (world/spawn 'player (car player-spawn) (cadr player-spawn))))
    (when goal-spawn
      (let ((g (world/spawn 'goal (car goal-spawn) (cadr goal-spawn))))
        (entity/shape! g 'rect 20 20)
        (entity/sensor! g #t)))
    (entity/shape! p 'rect 16 20)
    (entity/solid! p #t)
    (world/gravity! 0 0.5)
<|fim_suffix|>    (world/camera-follow! p 0.1 60 40)
    (world/camera-bounds! 0 0 960 240)
    (on-frame
     (lambda ()
       (when (input/down? 'left)  (entity/move! p -3 0))
       (when (input/down? 'right) (entity/move! p 3 0))
       (when (input/pressed? 'a)
         (entity/set-vel! p (car (entity/vel p)) -8))
       (world/step)
       ;; Check goal collision.
       (for-each
        (lambda (pair)
          (let ((a (car pair)) (b (cadr pair)))
            (when (or (and (eq? (entity/kind a) 'player)
                           (eq? (entity/kind b) 'goal))
                      (and (eq? (entity/kind b) 'player)
                           (eq? (entity/kind a) 'goal)))
              (paint-text \"YOU WIN!\" 120 100))))
        (world/collisions))
       (paint-clear)
       (world/each 'ground
                   (lambda (t)
                     (paint-cell 'ground (entity/x t) (entity/y t) 32 20)))
       (world/each 'goal
                   (lambda (g)
                     (paint-cell 'goal (entity/x g) (entity/y g) 20 20)))
       (paint-cell 'player (entity/x p) (entity/y p) 16 20)))))

(define boss-phase 1)
(define attack-tick 0)

(define (boss-fight)
  (world/reset!)
  (collision/define-layers!
   '((player :collides-with (boss boss-bullet))
     (boss   :collides-with (player player-bullet))
     (player-bullet :collides-with (boss))
     (boss-bullet   :collides-with (player))))
  (let ((p (world/spawn 'player 160 210))
        (b (world/spawn 'boss   160 40)))
    (entity/shape! p 'triangle 8)  (entity/layer! p 'player)
    (entity/shape! b 'rect 40 40) (entity/layer! b 'boss)
    (entity/hp! p 5) (entity/hp! b 100)
    (entity/solid! p #t) (entity/solid! b #t)
    (on-frame
     (lambda ()
       (when (input/down? 'left)  (entity/move! p -4 0))
       (when (input/down? 'right) (entity/move! p 4 0))
       (when (input/pressed? 'a)
         (let ((bul (world/spawn 'player-bullet
                                 (entity/x p) (- (entity/y p) 8))))
           (entity/shape! bul 'circle 2)
           (entity/layer! bul 'player-bullet)
           (entity/set-vel! bul 0 -6)))
       ;; Phase-transition detection.
       (let ((hp (entity/hp! b 0)))
         (cond
           ((and (< hp 66) (= boss-phase 1))
            (set! boss-phase 2)
            (world/camera-shake! 10 0.95)
<|fim_middle|>            (audio/play 'phase-shift))
           ((and (< hp 33) (= boss-phase 2))
            (set! boss-phase 3)
            (world/camera-shake! 15 0.97)
            (audio/play 'phase-shift))))
       ;; Attack routing.
       (cond ((= boss-phase 1) (phase-1-attack b p))
             ((= boss-phase 2) (phase-2-attack b p))
             ((= boss-phase 3) (phase-3-attack b p)))
       (set! attack-tick (+ attack-tick 1))
       (world/step)
       ;; Collision handling.
       (for-each
        (lambda (pair)
          (let ((a (car pair)) (bp (cadr pair)))
            (let ((kinds (list (entity/kind a) (entity/kind bp))))
              (cond
                ((or (equal? kinds '(player-bullet boss))
                     (equal? kinds '(boss player-bullet)))
                 (entity/damage! b 1)
                 (entity/despawn!
                  (if (eq? (entity/kind a) 'player-bullet) a bp)))
                ((or (equal? kinds '(boss-bullet player))
                     (equal? kinds '(player boss-bullet)))
                 (entity/damage! p 1)
                 (entity/despawn!
                  (if (eq? (entity/kind a) 'boss-bullet) a bp))
                 (world/camera-shake! 5 0.9))
                ((or (equal? kinds '(boss player))
                     (equal? kinds '(player boss)))
                 (entity/damage! p 1)
                 (world/camera-shake! 8 0.9))))))
        (world/collisions))
<|fim_suffix|>       ;; Cleanup off-screen bullets.

                   (lambda (bul)
                     (when (or (< (entity/x bul) -10) (> (entity/x bul) 330)
                               (< (entity/y bul) -10) (> (entity/y bul) 250))
                       (entity/despawn! bul))))
       (world/each 'player-bullet
                   (lambda (bul)
                     (when (< (entity/y bul) 0) (entity/despawn! bul))))
       ;; Boss death?
       (when (<= (entity/hp! b 0) 0)
         (paint-text \"VICTORY\" 130 100)
         (world/camera-shake! 20 0.97)
         (audio/play 'victory))
       (paint-clear)

         (paint-cell (case boss-phase ((1) 'boss1) ((2) 'boss2) ((3) 'boss3))
                     (entity/x b) (entity/y b) 40 40))
       (world/each 'boss-bullet
                   (lambda (bul)
                     (paint-cell 'boss-bullet (entity/x bul) (entity/y bul) 3 3)))
       (world/each 'player-bullet
                   (lambda (bul)
                     (paint-cell 'player-bullet (entity/x bul) (entity/y bul) 2 2)))
       (paint-cell 'player (entity/x p) (entity/y p) 8 8)
       (paint-text (string-append \"Boss HP: \" (number->string (entity/hp! b 0)))
                   10 10)
       (paint-text (string-append \"You HP: \" (number->string (entity/hp! p 0)))
                   10 20)
       (paint-text (string-append \"Phase: \" (number->string boss-phase))
                   10 30)))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; game.slat — full arcade shmup, ready to define-card.

(define game-state 'attract)
(define state-timer 0)
(define current-level 1)
(define current-score 0)
(define combo 0)
(define combo-decay-at 0)
(define player-hp 3)
(define boss-phase 1)
(define spawn-counter 0)

(define (init-play)
  (world/reset!)
  (collision/define-layers!
   '((player :collides-with (enemy enemy-bullet boss boss-bullet coin))
     (enemy  :collides-with (player player-bullet))
     (boss   :collides-with (player player-bullet))
     (player-bullet :collides-with (enemy boss))
     (enemy-bullet  :collides-with (player))
     (boss-bullet   :collides-with (player))
     (coin :collides-with (player))))
  (let ((p (world/spawn 'player 160 210)))
    (entity/shape! p 'triangle 8)
    (entity/layer! p 'player)
    (entity/solid! p #t))
  (set! player-hp 3)
  (set! current-score 0)
  (set! combo 0)
  (set! current-level 1))

(define (init-level lvl)
  ;; Clear enemies/bullets; keep player.
  (world/each 'enemy (lambda (e) (entity/despawn! e)))
  (world/each 'boss  (lambda (b) (entity/despawn! b)))
  (world/each 'enemy-bullet (lambda (b) (entity/despawn! b)))
  (world/each 'player-bullet (lambda (b) (entity/despawn! b)))
  (set! spawn-counter 0)
  (set! boss-phase 1)
  (when (= lvl 3)
    (let ((b (world/spawn 'boss 160 40)))
      (entity/shape! b 'rect 40 40)
      (entity/layer! b 'boss)
      (entity/hp! b 100))))

(define (transition new-state)
  (set! game-state new-state)
  (set! state-timer 0)
  (case new-state
    ((play) (init-play) (init-level 1))
    ((next-level)
     (set! current-level (+ current-level 1))
     (if (> current-level 3)
         (transition 'victory)
         (begin (init-level current-level)
                (transition 'play))))))

(define (level-tick p)
  (cond
    ((< current-level 3)
     ;; Levels 1-2: enemy waves.
     (set! spawn-counter (+ spawn-counter 1))
     (let ((spawn-rate (- 40 (* 5 current-level))))
       (when (>= spawn-counter spawn-rate)
         (set! spawn-counter 0)
         (let ((e (world/spawn 'enemy
                               (+ 20 (modulo (world/hash) 280))
                               -10)))
           (entity/shape! e 'rect 10 10)
           (entity/layer! e 'enemy)
           (entity/set-vel! e 0 (+ 1 (* 0.5 current-level)))
<|fim_middle|>           (entity/solid! e #t))))
     ;; Level complete after 30 seconds.
     (when (> state-timer (* 60 30))
       (transition 'next-level)))
    (else
     ;; Level 3: boss phase transitions.
     (world/each 'boss
                 (lambda (b)
                   (let ((hp (entity/hp! b 0)))
                     (cond
                       ((and (< hp 66) (= boss-phase 1))
                        (set! boss-phase 2)
                        (world/camera-shake! 10 0.95))
                       ((and (< hp 33) (= boss-phase 2))
                        (set! boss-phase 3)
                        (world/camera-shake! 15 0.97)))
                     ;; Basic boss shot cadence.
                     (when (= (modulo state-timer (case boss-phase
                                                    ((1) 60)
                                                    ((2) 30)
                                                    ((3) 90))) 0)
                       (let ((bul (world/spawn 'boss-bullet
                                               (entity/x b) (entity/y b))))
                         (entity/shape! bul 'circle 3)
                         (entity/layer! bul 'boss-bullet)
                         (entity/set-vel! bul 0 3)))
                     (when (<= hp 0)
                       (entity/despawn! b)
                       (transition 'victory)))))
     )))

(define (handle-collisions p)
  (for-each
   (lambda (pair)
     (let ((a (car pair)) (b (cadr pair)))
       (let ((kinds (list (entity/kind a) (entity/kind b))))
         (cond
           ((or (equal? kinds '(player-bullet enemy))
                (equal? kinds '(enemy player-bullet)))
            (entity/despawn! (if (eq? (entity/kind a) 'player-bullet) a b))
            (entity/despawn! (if (eq? (entity/kind a) 'enemy) a b))
            (set! combo (+ combo 1))
            (set! combo-decay-at (+ (world/frame) 60))
            (set! current-score (+ current-score (* 100 combo))))
           ((or (equal? kinds '(player-bullet boss))
                (equal? kinds '(boss player-bullet)))
            (entity/despawn! (if (eq? (entity/kind a) 'player-bullet) a b))
            (entity/damage! (if (eq? (entity/kind a) 'boss) a b) 1)
            (set! current-score (+ current-score 200)))
           ((or (equal? kinds '(enemy-bullet player))
                (equal? kinds '(player enemy-bullet))
                (equal? kinds '(boss-bullet player))
                (equal? kinds '(player boss-bullet)))
            (entity/despawn!
             (if (or (eq? (entity/kind a) 'enemy-bullet)
                     (eq? (entity/kind a) 'boss-bullet)) a b))
            (set! player-hp (- player-hp 1))
            (world/camera-shake! 8 0.9))))))
   (world/collisions))
  (when (>= (world/frame) combo-decay-at) (set! combo 0)))

(define (paint-hud)
  (paint-text (string-append \"Score: \" (number->string current-score)) 10 10)
  (paint-text (string-append \"HP: \" (number->string player-hp)) 10 20)
  (paint-text (string-append \"Level: \" (number->string current-level))
              10 30)
  (when (> combo 0)
    (paint-text (string-append \"x\" (number->string combo)) 260 20)))

(define (game-frame)
  (set! state-timer (+ state-timer 1))
<|fim_suffix|>  (paint-clear)
  (case game-state
    ((attract)
     (paint-text \"MY ARCADE GAME\" 100 60)
     (paint-text \"PRESS START\"
                 (+ 100 (round (* 15 (tick/sine (* 0.05 state-timer)))))
                 140)
     (paint-text (string-append \"High: \"
                                (number->string
                                 (or (cortex/read 'my-game-high) 0)))
                 110 190)
     (when (input/pressed? 'a) (transition 'play)))
    ((play)
     (let ((p (car (world/find 'player))))
       (when (input/down? 'left)  (entity/move! p -4 0))
       (when (input/down? 'right) (entity/move! p 4 0))
       (when (input/pressed? 'a)
         (let ((bul (world/spawn 'player-bullet
                                 (entity/x p) (- (entity/y p) 8))))
           (entity/shape! bul 'circle 2)
           (entity/layer! bul 'player-bullet)
           (entity/set-vel! bul 0 -6)))
       (level-tick p)
       (world/step)
       (handle-collisions p)
       (world/each 'player-bullet
                   (lambda (b) (when (< (entity/y b) 0) (entity/despawn! b))))
       (world/each 'enemy
                   (lambda (e) (when (> (entity/y e) 250) (entity/despawn! e))))
       (world/each 'enemy-bullet
                   (lambda (b) (when (> (entity/y b) 250) (entity/despawn! b))))
       (when (<= player-hp 0) (transition 'game-over))
       (world/each 'enemy
                   (lambda (e) (paint-cell 'enemy (entity/x e) (entity/y e) 10 10)))
       (world/each 'boss
                   (lambda (b) (paint-cell 'boss (entity/x b) (entity/y b) 40 40)))
       (world/each 'player-bullet
                   (lambda (b) (paint-cell 'bullet (entity/x b) (entity/y b) 2 2)))
       (world/each 'enemy-bullet
                   (lambda (b) (paint-cell 'enemy-bullet (entity/x b) (entity/y b) 3 3)))
       (world/each 'boss-bullet
                   (lambda (b) (paint-cell 'boss-bullet (entity/x b) (entity/y b) 3 3)))
       (paint-cell 'player (entity/x p) (entity/y p) 8 8)
       (paint-hud)))
    ((game-over)
     (paint-text \"GAME OVER\" 120 100)
     (paint-text (string-append \"Score: \" (number->string current-score))
                 110 130)
     (when (> current-score (or (cortex/read 'my-game-high) 0))
       (cortex/write 'my-game-high current-score))
     (when (> state-timer 180) (transition 'attract)))
    ((victory)
     (paint-text \"YOU WIN!\" 125 90)
     (paint-text (string-append \"Score: \" (number->string current-score))
                 110 120)
     (when (> current-score (or (cortex/read 'my-game-high) 0))
       (cortex/write 'my-game-high current-score))
     (when (> state-timer 240) (transition 'attract)))))

(define (my-arcade-game)
  (transition 'attract)
  (on-frame game-frame))

;; Publish as a card so friends can play from a URL.
(define-card 'my-arcade-game
  :title \"My Arcade Game\"
  :entry my-arcade-game
  :description \"3 levels + boss. Built with Motoi Scheme.\"
  :cortex-keys '(my-game-high))

(big-bang my-arcade-game)

            (let* ((products fetch-result)

                                  (let ((price-entry (assoc \"price\" product)))
                                    (if price-entry
                                        (cdr price-entry)
                                        0)))
                                products))

                   (p75 (percentile 75 sorted-prices))

                                 (cond

  (let* ((n (length sorted-xs))

    (if (>= idx n)

<|fim_prefix|>;; Define a pipeline as a list of (verb-name . args) pairs, execute it stage by stage.
;; If any stage fails, stop and return the failure.

(define (execute-pipeline pipeline-spec data)
  (if (null? pipeline-spec)
      data  ; no more stages, return accumulated data
      (let ((stage (car pipeline-spec)))
        (let ((verb-name (car stage))
<|fim_middle|>              (args (cdr stage)))
          ;; In real code, you'd dispatch on verb-name and call the verb.
          ;; Here we simulate: if verb-name is 'fetch, call web/fetch; etc.
          (let ((result (cond
                         ((eq? verb-name 'fetch) (apply web/fetch args))
                         ((eq? verb-name 'parse) (apply documents/parse args))
                         ((eq? verb-name 'filter) (filter (car args) data))
                         (else '(escalate \"unknown-verb\" verb-name)))))
<|fim_suffix|>            (if (or (eq? result 'nan)
                    (and (pair? result) (eq? (car result) 'escalate)))
                result
                (execute-pipeline (cdr pipeline-spec) result)))))))

;; Example pipeline: fetch a URL, parse it, filter non-empty lines
(let ((pipeline '((fetch . (\"https://example.com\"))
                  (filter . ((lambda (line) (not (string=? line \"\"))))))))
  (execute-pipeline pipeline '()))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Compute exponential moving average with smoothing factor alpha.
;; alpha should be between 0 and 1 (typical: 0.1 to 0.3).
(define (ema series alpha)
  (if (null? series)
      '()
      (let loop ((remaining (cdr series))
<|fim_middle|>                 (current-ema (car series))
                 (result (list (car series))))
        (if (null? remaining)
            (reverse result)
            (let ((new-ema (+ (* alpha (car remaining))
                              (* (- 1 alpha) current-ema))))
<|fim_suffix|>              (loop (cdr remaining)
                    new-ema
                    (cons new-ema result)))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Compute cosine similarity between two numeric vectors, with guards.
;; Returns similarity (0 to 1), or 'nan if inputs are invalid.
(define (cosine-sim v1 v2)
  (cond
   ((not (= (length v1) (length v2)))
    'nan)
   ((or (null? v1) (null? v2))
    'nan)
   (else
<|fim_middle|>    (let* ((dot (apply + (map * v1 v2)))
           (mag1 (sqrt (apply + (map (lambda (x) (* x x)) v1))))
           (mag2 (sqrt (apply + (map (lambda (x) (* x x)) v2)))))
      (if (or (= mag1 0) (= mag2 0))
          'nan
          (/ dot (* mag1 mag2)))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Find the vector in candidates most similar to query (highest cosine similarity).
;; Returns (index . similarity), or 'nan if no valid candidates.
(define (most-similar query candidates)
  (if (null? candidates)
      'nan
      (let loop ((remaining candidates)
                 (index 0)
                 (best-idx -1)
                 (best-sim -1))
<|fim_middle|>        (if (null? remaining)
            (if (= best-idx -1)
                'nan
                (cons best-idx best-sim))
            (let ((sim (cosine-sim query (car remaining))))
              (if (and (not (eq? sim 'nan)) (> sim best-sim))
                  (loop (cdr remaining) (+ index 1) index sim)
                  (loop (cdr remaining) (+ index 1) best-idx best-sim)))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Compute a comprehensive stats summary for a numeric series.
;; Returns an association list with keys: count mean p50 p95 velocity,

(define (stats-summary series)
  (cond

<|fim_middle|>           (total (apply + series))
           (mean (/ total count))
           (p50 (stats/percentile series 50))
           (p95 (stats/percentile series 95))
           (vel (stats/velocity series)))
      (list (cons 'count count)
            (cons 'mean mean)
            (cons 'p50 p50)
            (cons 'p95 p95)
            (cons 'velocity vel))))))

<|fim_middle|>        (escalate 'no-valid-candidates candidates)

                (escalate 'no-match-within-threshold
                          (list (cons 'target target)
                                (cons 'best best)
                                (cons 'threshold threshold)))))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Simple template engine: replace {{key}} with values from an alist.
(define (template tmpl alist)
  (define (find-placeholder str start)
    ;; Find the next {{ in the string starting at index start.
    ;; Returns (start-idx . end-idx) or #f if not found.
    (define (search idx)
      (cond
        ((>= idx (- (string-length str) 1)) #f)
        ((and (char=? (string-ref str idx) #\\{)
              (char=? (string-ref str (+ idx 1)) #\\{))
         (let ((end (find-close str (+ idx 2))))
           (if end
               (cons idx end)
               #f)))
        (else (search (+ idx 1)))))
    (search start))

    ;; Find the next }} starting at index start.
    (define (search idx)
      (cond
        ((>= idx (- (string-length str) 1)) #f)
        ((and (char=? (string-ref str idx) #\\})
              (char=? (string-ref str (+ idx 1)) #\\}))
         (+ idx 2))
        (else (search (+ idx 1)))))
    (search start))
  
  (define (substitute str)
    (let ((match (find-placeholder str 0)))
      (if match
          (let ((start (car match))
                (end (cdr match)))
            (let ((key-str (substring str (+ start 2) (- end 2))))
<|fim_suffix|>              (let ((key (string->symbol key-str)))

                                                     (cons 'template tmpl))))))))

(define (csv-transform-report csv-str)
  (define (split-on-char str ch)
    (define (split-helper chars acc word-acc)
      (cond
        ((null? chars)
         (reverse (cons (list->string (reverse word-acc)) acc)))
        ((char=? (car chars) ch)
         (split-helper (cdr chars)
                       (cons (list->string (reverse word-acc)) acc)
                       '()))
        (else
         (split-helper (cdr chars) acc (cons (car chars) word-acc)))))

  ;; Step 1: Parse CSV into list of rows (each row is a list of fields).
  (define (parse-csv text)
    (let ((lines (split-on-char text #\\newline)))
      (if (null? lines)
          (escalate 'empty-csv text)
          (let ((header (split-on-char (car lines) #\\,)))
            (let ((rows (map (lambda (line) (split-on-char line #\\,)) (cdr lines))))
              (if (any? (lambda (row) (not (= (length row) (length header)))) rows)
                  (escalate 'uneven-columns text)
                  (cons header rows)))))))
  
  (define (any? pred lst)
    (and (not (null? lst))
         (or (pred (car lst))
             (any? pred (cdr lst)))))
<|fim_middle|>  
  ;; Step 2: Transform each row—normalize role, compute seniority.
  (define (transform-rows header rows)
    (define name-idx (list-index \"name\" header))
    (define role-idx (list-index \"role\" header))
    (define years-idx (list-index \"years\" header))
    
    (define (list-index item lst)
      (define (search idx remaining)
        (cond
          ((null? remaining) #f)
          ((equal? (car remaining) item) idx)
          (else (search (+ idx 1) (cdr remaining)))))
      (search 0 lst))
    
    (if (or (not name-idx) (not role-idx) (not years-idx))
        (escalate 'missing-columns (list (cons 'header header)
                                         (cons 'expected '(\"name\" \"role\" \"years\"))))
        (map (lambda (row)
               (let ((name (list-ref row name-idx))
                     (role (list-ref row role-idx))
                     (years-str (list-ref row years-idx)))
                 (let ((years (string->number years-str)))
                   (if (not years)
                       (escalate 'invalid-years years-str)
                       (let ((norm-role (text/normalize role)))
                         (if (equal? norm-role 'nan)
                             (escalate 'normalize-failed role)
                             (let ((seniority (cond
                                                ((< years 2) \"junior\")
<|fim_suffix|>                                                ((< years 5) \"mid-level\")
                                                (else \"senior\"))))
                               (list (cons 'name name)
                                     (cons 'role norm-role)
                                     (cons 'years years)
                                     (cons 'seniority seniority)))))))))
             rows)))
  
  ;; Step 3: Format each transformed row as a summary line.
  (define (format-report rows)
    (define (format-one row)
      (let ((name (cdr (assoc 'name row)))
            (role (cdr (assoc 'role row)))
            (years (cdr (assoc 'years row)))

(define (recursive-template root-template values templates max-depth)

              (char=? (string-ref str (+ idx 1)) #\\{))
         (let ((end (find-close str (+ idx 2))))
           (if end
               (cons idx end)
               #f)))
        (else (search (+ idx 1)))))
    (search start))

    (define (search idx)
      (cond
        ((>= idx (- (string-length str) 1)) #f)
        ((and (char=? (string-ref str idx) #\\})
              (char=? (string-ref str (+ idx 1)) #\\}))
<|fim_middle|>         (+ idx 2))

    (search start))

        (let ((match (find-placeholder str 0)))

                    (end (cdr match)))

                  (let ((key (string->symbol key-str)))
                    (let ((value-entry (assoc key values))

                                     (substring str 0 start)

                           (let ((expanded-tmpl (expand tmpl (+ depth 1))))

                                           (substring str 0 start)

(define (find-near-duplicates titles threshold)
  (define (normalize-and-slug title)
    (let ((norm (text/normalize title)))
      (if (equal? norm 'nan)
          (escalate 'normalize-failed title)
          (let ((slug (system/slugify norm)))
            (if (equal? slug 'nan)
                (escalate 'slugify-failed norm)
                (list (cons 'title title)
                      (cons 'slug slug)))))))
  
  (define (all-pairs lst)
    (define (pairs-with-first first rest)
      (if (null? rest)
          '()
          (cons (cons first (car rest))
                (pairs-with-first first (cdr rest)))))
    (if (null? lst)
        '()
<|fim_middle|>        (append (pairs-with-first (car lst) (cdr lst))
                (all-pairs (cdr lst)))))
  
  (define (compute-distance pair)
    (let ((slug-a (cdr (assoc 'slug (car pair))))
          (slug-b (cdr (assoc 'slug (cdr pair)))))
      (let ((dist (text/distance slug-a slug-b)))
        (if (equal? dist 'nan)
            (escalate 'distance-failed (list slug-a slug-b))
            (list (cons 'title-a (cdr (assoc 'title (car pair))))
                  (cons 'title-b (cdr (assoc 'title (cdr pair))))
                  (cons 'slug-a slug-a)
                  (cons 'slug-b slug-b)
                  (cons 'distance dist))))))
  
  (let ((processed (map normalize-and-slug titles)))
    (if (any? (lambda (x) (and (pair? x) (equal? (car x) 'escalate))) processed)
        (car (filter (lambda (x) (and (pair? x) (equal? (car x) 'escalate))) processed))

                      near))))))))

(define (full-text-pipeline csv-str min-years template-str min-words max-words max-grade)
  (define (split-on-char str ch)
    (define (split-helper chars acc word-acc)
      (cond
        ((null? chars)
         (reverse (cons (list->string (reverse word-acc)) acc)))
        ((char=? (car chars) ch)
         (split-helper (cdr chars)
                       (cons (list->string (reverse word-acc)) acc)
                       '()))
        (else
         (split-helper (cdr chars) acc (cons (car chars) word-acc)))))
    (split-helper (string->list str) '() '()))
  
  ;; Step 1: Parse CSV.
  (define (parse-csv text)
    (let ((lines (split-on-char text #\\newline)))
      (if (null? lines)
          (escalate 'empty-csv text)
          (let ((header (split-on-char (car lines) #\\,)))
            (let ((rows (map (lambda (line) (split-on-char line #\\,)) (cdr lines))))
              (if (any? (lambda (row) (not (= (length row) (length header)))) rows)
                  (escalate 'uneven-columns text)
                  (cons header rows)))))))
  
  (define (any? pred lst)
    (and (not (null? lst))
         (or (pred (car lst))
             (any? pred (cdr lst)))))
  
  ;; Step 2: Transform rows.
  (define (transform-rows header rows)
    (define name-idx (list-index \"name\" header))
    (define role-idx (list-index \"role\" header))
    (define years-idx (list-index \"years\" header))
    
    (define (list-index item lst)
      (define (search idx remaining)
        (cond
          ((null? remaining) #f)
          ((equal? (car remaining) item) idx)
          (else (search (+ idx 1) (cdr remaining)))))
      (search 0 lst))
    
    (if (or (not name-idx) (not role-idx) (not years-idx))
        (escalate 'missing-columns (list (cons 'header header)
                                         (cons 'expected '(\"name\" \"role\" \"years\"))))
        (map (lambda (row)
               (let ((name (list-ref row name-idx))
                     (role (list-ref row role-idx))
                     (years-str (list-ref row years-idx)))
                 (let ((years (string->number years-str)))
                   (if (not years)
                       (escalate 'invalid-years years-str)
                       (let ((norm-role (text/normalize role)))
                         (if (equal? norm-role 'nan)
<|fim_middle|>                             (escalate 'normalize-failed role)
                             (list (cons 'name name)
                                   (cons 'role norm-role)
                                   (cons 'years years))))))))
             rows)))
  
  ;; Step 3: Filter by minimum years.
  (define (filter-by-years rows min-y)
    (filter (lambda (row)
              (>= (cdr (assoc 'years row)) min-y))
            rows))
  
  ;; Step 4: Template each row into a message.
  (define (template-rows rows tmpl)
    (define (find-placeholder str start)
      (define (search idx)
        (cond
          ((>= idx (- (string-length str) 1)) #f)
          ((and (char=? (string-ref str idx) #\\{)
                (char=? (string-ref str (+ idx 1)) #\\{))
           (let ((end (find-close str (+ idx 2))))
             (if end
                 (cons idx end)
                 #f)))
          (else (search (+ idx 1)))))
      (search start))
    
    (define (find-close str start)
      (define (search idx)
        (cond
          ((>= idx (- (string-length str) 1)) #f)
          ((and (char=? (string-ref str idx) #\\})
                (char=? (string-ref str (+ idx 1)) #\\}))
           (+ idx 2))
          (else (search (+ idx 1)))))
      (search start))
    
    (define (template-one alist)
      (define (substitute str)
        (let ((match (find-placeholder str 0)))
          (if match
              (let ((start (car match))
                    (end (cdr match)))
                (let ((key-str (substring str (+ start 2) (- end 2))))
                  (let ((key (string->symbol key-str)))
                    (let ((entry (assoc key alist)))
                      (if entry
                          (let ((value (cond
                                         ((string? (cdr entry)) (cdr entry))
                                         ((number? (cdr entry)) (number->string (cdr entry)))
                                         (else (symbol->string (cdr entry))))))
                            (substitute (string-append
                                          (substring str 0 start)
                                          value
                                          (substring str end (string-length str)))))
                          (escalate 'key-not-found (list (cons 'key key)
                                                         (cons 'template tmpl))))))))
<|fim_suffix|>              str)))
      (substitute tmpl))
    
    (map template-one rows))

  (define (validate-messages messages)
    (define (validate-one msg)
      (let ((wc (text/word-count msg)))
        (if (equal? wc 'nan)
            (escalate 'word-count-failed msg)
            (let ((grade (text/flesch-kincaid msg)))
              (if (equal? grade 'nan)
                  (escalate 'readability-failed msg)
                  (cond
                    ((< wc min-words)
                     (escalate 'too-short (list (cons 'message msg)
                                                (cons 'words wc)
                                                (cons 'min min-words))))
                    ((> wc max-words)
                     (escalate 'too-long (list (cons 'message msg)
                                               (cons 'words wc)
                                               (cons 'max max-words))))
                    ((> grade max-grade)
                     (escalate 'too-complex (list (cons 'message msg)
                                                  (cons 'grade grade)
                                                  (cons 'max max-grade))))
                    (else msg)))))))
    
    (let ((validated (map validate-one messages)))
      (if (any? (lambda (x) (and (pair? x) (equal? (car x) 'escalate))) validated)
          (car (filter (lambda (x) (and (pair? x) (equal? (car x) 'escalate))) validated))
          validated)))
  
  ;; Pipeline: parse → transform → filter → template → validate.
  (let ((parsed (parse-csv csv-str)))
    (if (and (pair? parsed) (equal? (car parsed) 'escalate))
        parsed
        (let ((header (car parsed))
              (rows (cdr parsed)))
          (let ((transformed (transform-rows header rows)))
            (if (and (pair? transformed) (equal? (car transformed) 'escalate))
                transformed
                (let ((filtered (filter-by-years transformed min-years)))
                  (if (null? filtered)
                      (escalate 'no-matches min-years)
                      (let ((templated (template-rows filtered template-str)))
                        (if (and (pair? templated) (equal? (car templated) 'escalate))

              ;; Already visited—skip
              (loop (cdr to-visit) visited deps)
              ;; Visit this node
              (let ((neighbors (cortex/lookup current \"depends-on\")))
                (if (or (eq? neighbors 'nan)
                        (and (pair? neighbors) (eq? (car neighbors) 'escalate)))
<|fim_suffix|>                    ;; No neighbors or error—mark visited and continue
                    (loop (cdr to-visit) (cons current visited) deps)
                    ;; Add neighbors to to-visit and deps

                          (append neighbors deps)))))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Given a start product and an end product, find the shortest path of
;; \"related-to\" associations between them. Returns a list of keys forming
;; the path, or 'no-path if unreachable.

(define (shortest-path start-key end-key)
  (let loop ((queue (list (list start-key)))  ; queue of paths
             (visited (list start-key)))
    (if (null? queue)
        'no-path  ; queue exhausted—no path exists
        (let* ((path (car queue))
               (current (car (reverse path))))  ; last node in path
<|fim_middle|>          (if (equal? current end-key)
              path  ; found it
              (let ((neighbors (cortex/lookup current \"related-to\")))
                (if (or (eq? neighbors 'nan)
                        (and (pair? neighbors) (eq? (car neighbors) 'escalate)))
                    ;; No neighbors—try next path in queue
                    (loop (cdr queue) visited)
                    ;; Add unvisited neighbors to queue
                    (let extend ((nbrs neighbors)
                                 (new-queue (cdr queue))
                                 (new-visited visited))
<|fim_suffix|>                      (if (null? nbrs)
                          (loop new-queue new-visited)
                          (let ((nbr (car nbrs)))
                            (if (member nbr new-visited)
                                (extend (cdr nbrs) new-queue new-visited)
                                (extend (cdr nbrs)
                                        (append new-queue (list (append path (list nbr))))
                                        (cons nbr new-visited)))))))))))))

;; Example call:
(shortest-path \"product:lamp-01\" \"product:lamp-05\")
;; => (\"product:lamp-01\" \"product:lamp-03\" \"product:lamp-05\")

<|fim_prefix|>;; Given a list of past decisions (each with timestamp and score), apply an
;; exponential decay: older decisions are weighted less. Return a sorted list
;; of (key . decayed-score) pairs.

(define (decay-scores decision-keys half-life-days)
  ;; half-life is the number of days for a score to decay to 50%
  (let ((now (time/unix-now))
        (half-life-seconds (* half-life-days 86400)))
    (let loop ((keys decision-keys)
               (scored '()))
      (if (null? keys)
          ;; Sort by decayed score, descending
          (list-sort (lambda (a b) (> (cdr a) (cdr b))) scored)
<|fim_middle|>          (let ((record (cortex/recall (car keys))))
            (if (or (eq? record 'nan)
                    (and (pair? record) (eq? (car record) 'escalate)))
                (loop (cdr keys) scored)
                (let ((timestamp (cdr (assoc 'timestamp record)))
                      (raw-score (cdr (assoc 'score record))))
                  (let* ((age (- now timestamp))
                         (decay-factor (expt 0.5 (/ age half-life-seconds)))
                         (decayed (math/round (* raw-score decay-factor) 2)))
                    (loop (cdr keys) (cons (cons (car keys) decayed) scored))))))))))

;; Helper: list-sort (simple insertion sort for demonstration)
(define (list-sort less? lst)
<|fim_suffix|>  (if (null? lst)
      '()
      (insert (car lst) (list-sort less? (cdr lst)) less?)))

(define (insert x sorted less?)
  (if (null? sorted)
      (list x)
      (if (less? x (car sorted))
          (cons x sorted)
          (cons (car sorted) (insert x (cdr sorted) less?)))))

;; Example call (assumes decisions were stored with timestamps and scores):
(decay-scores '(\"decision:d-101\" \"decision:d-102\" \"decision:d-103\") 30)
;; => ((\"decision:d-103\" . 0.92) (\"decision:d-102\" . 0.67) (\"decision:d-101\" . 0.23))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Scan all \"product:*\" keys, check the last-updated timestamp, and regenerate
;; descriptions for any that are older than threshold days.

(define (refresh-stale-descriptions threshold-days)
  (let ((cutoff (- (time/unix-now) (* threshold-days 86400))))
    (let ((all-keys (cortex/scan \"product:\")))
      (if (eq? all-keys 'nan)
          '()
          (if (and (pair? all-keys) (eq? (car all-keys) 'escalate))
              all-keys
              (let loop ((keys all-keys)
                         (refreshed '()))
                (if (null? keys)
                    (reverse refreshed)
<|fim_middle|>                    (let ((record (cortex/recall (car keys))))
                      (if (or (eq? record 'nan)
                              (and (pair? record) (eq? (car record) 'escalate)))
                          (loop (cdr keys) refreshed)
                          (let ((last-updated (cdr (assoc 'last-updated record)))
                                (prod-name (cdr (assoc 'name record))))
                            (if (< last-updated cutoff)
                                ;; Stale—regenerate description
                                (let ((prompt (string-append \"Write a product description for: \" prod-name)))
                                  (let ((new-desc (model/draft prompt)))
                                    (if (eq? new-desc 'nan)
                                        (loop (cdr keys) refreshed)
                                        ;; Write back updated record
                                        (let ((updated-record (cons (cons 'description new-desc)
<|fim_suffix|>                                                                    (cons (cons 'last-updated (time/unix-now))
                                                                          (filter (lambda (e)
                                                                                    (not (or (eq? (car e) 'description)
                                                                                             (eq? (car e) 'last-updated))))
                                                                                  record)))))
                                          (let ((write-res (cortex/write (car keys) updated-record)))
                                            (if (and (pair? write-res) (eq? (car write-res) 'escalate))
                                                (loop (cdr keys) refreshed)
                                                (loop (cdr keys) (cons (car keys) refreshed))))))))
                                ;; Fresh—skip
                                (loop (cdr keys) refreshed))))))))))))

;; the stored email in cortex, and update cortex if the CRM has a newer value.

(define (sync-customer-email-from-crm customer-id)
  (let ((cortex-key (string-append \"customer:\" customer-id)))

    (let ((stored (cortex/recall cortex-key)))
      (if (and (pair? stored) (eq? (car stored) 'escalate))

          ;; Step 2: fetch from CRM
<|fim_middle|>          (let ((crm-data (crm/read customer-id)))

                    ;; Step 3: extract emails and timestamps
                    (let ((stored-email (if (eq? stored 'nan) #f (cdr (assoc 'email stored))))

                          (crm-ts (cdr (assoc 'updated-at crm-data))))
<|fim_suffix|>                      ;; Step 4: reconcile—CRM wins if its timestamp is newer
                      (if (> crm-ts stored-ts)
                          ;; Update cortex
                          (let ((new-record (list (cons 'email crm-email)

;; This is a cond ladder with real verb use and honest-null handling.

(define (route-message raw-message)

        (cond

               (string-contains? normalized \"return\"))

          ((or (string-contains? normalized \"shipping\")
<|fim_middle|>               (string-contains? normalized \"delivery\"))

               (string-contains? normalized \"quality\"))

          ((string-contains? normalized \"urgent\")
           (list 'team 'escalation 'priority 'urgent))
          (else

(define (string-contains? haystack needle)
<|fim_suffix|>  (and (string? haystack)
       (string? needle)
       (let ((h-len (string-length haystack))
             (n-len (string-length needle)))
         (let loop ((i 0))
           (cond
             ((> (+ i n-len) h-len) #f)
             ((string=? (substring haystack i (+ i n-len)) needle) #t)
             (else (loop (+ i 1))))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Mutually recursive validation and enrichment with a retry limit.
;; validate checks fields; if missing, calls enrich.

(letrec ((validate (lambda (record tries-left)
                     (cond

                        (list 'status 'failed 'reason \"Max retries exceeded\" 'record record))
                       ((not (assoc 'email record))
<|fim_middle|>                        ;; Missing email, try to enrich
                        (enrich record 'email tries-left))

<|fim_suffix|>                     (if (not customer-id)
                         (list 'status 'failed 'reason \"No customer ID\" 'record record)
                         (let ((crm-data (crm/read customer-id)))
                           (if (eq? crm-data 'nan)
                               (list 'status 'failed 'reason \"CRM lookup failed\" 'record record)
                               (let ((value (cdr (assoc field crm-data))))
                                 (if value
                                     ;; Got it, add to record and re-validate
                                     (validate (cons (cons field value) record) (- tries-left 1))
                                     ;; Still missing, fail
                                     (list 'status 'failed 'reason \"Field not in CRM\" 'record record))))))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Retry wrapper with exponential backoff.
;; Tries a verb call up to max-retries times, doubling wait-ms each time.

(define (retry-with-backoff verb args max-retries wait-ms)
  (define (attempt n wait)
    (let ((result (apply verb args)))
      (if (not (eq? result 'nan))
          result  ; success, return it
<|fim_middle|>          (if (<= n 1)
              (list 'escalate \"Max retries exceeded\" (list 'verb verb 'args args))
              (begin
                ;; Wait (simulate with a computation delay since we don't have sleep)
                ;; In real usage, you'd use a system/sleep or similar
                (let loop ((i 0))
                  (if (< i wait) (loop (+ i 1)) 'ok))
                (attempt (- n 1) (* wait 2)))))))  ; double the wait
<|fim_suffix|>  (attempt max-retries wait-ms))

;; Example: wrap a cortex/recall call with retry
(define (resilient-recall key)
  (retry-with-backoff cortex/recall (list key) 3 100))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Mutually recursive evaluator for arithmetic expression trees.
;; An expr is either a number or (op left right).

(letrec ((eval-expr (lambda (expr)
                      (if (number? expr)
                          expr
                          (let ((op (car expr))
<|fim_middle|>                                (left (cadr expr))
                                (right (caddr expr)))
                            (let ((l-val (eval-expr left))
                                  (r-val (eval-expr right)))
                              (case op
                                ((add) (+ l-val r-val))
                                ((mul) (* l-val r-val))
<|fim_suffix|>                                (else 0)))))))
         (eval-list (lambda (exprs)
                      (if (null? exprs)
                          '()
                          (cons (eval-expr (car exprs))
                                (eval-list (cdr exprs)))))))
  (eval-list '((add 3 4) (mul 5 6) (add (mul 2 3) 10))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Mutually recursive dependency resolver with accumulation.
;; A task is (task id deps...) where each dep is also a task.

(letrec ((resolve-task (lambda (t acc)
                         ;; Resolve one task: add its ID to acc, then resolve its dependencies
                         (if (not (and (pair? t) (eq? (car t) 'task)))
                             acc  ; malformed, skip
                             (let ((id (cadr t))
                                   (deps (cddr t)))
<|fim_middle|>                               (let ((acc-with-id (cons id acc)))
                                 (resolve-tasks deps acc-with-id)))))
         (resolve-tasks (lambda (ts acc)
                          ;; Resolve a list of tasks
                          (if (null? ts)
                              acc
                              (let ((acc-after-first (resolve-task (car ts) acc)))
                                (resolve-tasks (cdr ts) acc-after-first))))))
  (reverse
<|fim_suffix|>   (resolve-tasks
    '((task \"build-site\"
            (task \"compile-assets\")
            (task \"bundle-js\"
                  (task \"transpile\")
                  (task \"minify\")))
      (task \"deploy\"
            (task \"test\")))
    '())))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Full product-publishing pipeline with retry, validation, and conditional routing.

(define (publish-product-pipeline product-id)
  ;; Stage 1: Fetch product with retry
  (let ((product (retry-fetch printify/product product-id 2)))
    (if (and (pair? product) (eq? (car product) 'escalate))
        product  ; failed, escalate
        ;; Stage 2: Validate product data
        (let ((valid (validate-product product)))
          (if (not valid)
              (list 'escalate \"Product validation failed\" product)
              ;; Stage 3: Check inventory
              (let ((inv (retry-fetch stock/on-hand product-id 2)))
                (if (and (pair? inv) (eq? (car inv) 'escalate))
                    inv  ; failed, escalate
                    (cond
                      ;; Route A: No inventory, create backorder workflow
                      ((= inv 0)
                       (let ((backorder (create-backorder product-id product)))
                         (list 'status 'backorder 'product product 'backorder backorder)))
                      ;; Route B: Low inventory, warn but continue
                      ((< inv 5)
                       (let ((published (retry-publish product-id 2)))
<|fim_middle|>                         (if (and (pair? published) (eq? (car published) 'escalate))
                             published
                             (list 'status 'published 'product product 'inventory inv 'warning \"Low stock\"))))
                      ;; Route C: Normal inventory, full publish workflow
                      (else
                       (let ((images (retry-fetch printify/mockups product-id 2)))
                         (if (and (pair? images) (eq? (car images) 'escalate))
                             ;; Images failed, publish without them
                             (let ((published (retry-publish product-id 2)))
                               (list 'status 'published 'product product 'inventory inv 'images 'none))
                             ;; Images OK, full publish
                             (let ((published (retry-publish product-id 2)))
                               (if (and (pair? published) (eq? (car published) 'escalate))
                                   published
                                   (list 'status 'published 'product product 'inventory inv 'images images))))))))))))))

;; Helper: retry a fetch verb twice
(define (retry-fetch verb arg retries)
  (let ((result (verb arg)))
    (if (not (eq? result 'nan))
        result
        (if (<= retries 1)
            (list 'escalate \"Fetch failed after retries\" (list 'verb verb 'arg arg))
<|fim_suffix|>            (retry-fetch verb arg (- retries 1))))))

;; Helper: retry a publish action
(define (retry-publish product-id retries)
  (let ((result (printify/product-publish product-id)))
    (if (not (eq? result 'nan))
        result
        (if (<= retries 1)
            (list 'escalate \"Publish failed after retries\" product-id)
            (retry-publish product-id (- retries 1))))))

;; Helper: validate product shape (simplified)
(define (validate-product product)
  (and (pair? product)
       (assoc 'id product)
       (assoc 'title product)))

(define (create-backorder product-id product)
  ;; In real usage, write to a DB or queue
  (list 'backorder-id (string-append \"BO-\" product-id) 'product product 'created (time/now)))

(publish-product-pipeline \"PROD-XYZ\")

        (let ((result (process-event (car remaining))))

<|fim_suffix|>                    (loop (cdr remaining)

<|fim_prefix|>;; Recommend products by keyword match and ranking.
(define (recommend-products query)
  (let* (;; Stage 1: extract keywords (simplified: split on spaces)
         (keywords (string-split query #\\space))
         
         ;; Stage 2: recall candidate products
         (raw (cortex/recall \"products\" \"catalog\"))
         (products (if (or (eq? raw 'nan)
                           (and (pair? raw) (eq? (car raw) 'escalate)))
                       '()
                       raw))
         
         ;; Stage 3: match—score each product by keyword overlap
         (scored (map
                  (lambda (product)
                    (let* ((name (cdr (assoc 'name product)))
                           (desc (cdr (assoc 'description product)))
                           (text (string-append name \" \" desc))
                           (matches (length
                                     (filter
                                      (lambda (kw)
                                        (string-contains text kw))
                                      keywords))))
                      (cons (cons 'score matches) product)))
                  products))
<|fim_middle|>         
         ;; Stage 4: rank by score descending
         (ranked (sort scored
                       (lambda (a b)
                         (> (cdr (assoc 'score a))
                            (cdr (assoc 'score b))))))
         
         ;; Stage 5: filter to top 3
         (top3 (take ranked (min 3 (length ranked))))
         
         ;; Stage 6: format as list of names
         (names (map (lambda (p) (cdr (assoc 'name p))) top3)))
    
    (if (null? names)
        \"No matching products found.\"
        (string-append
         \"Top matches: \"
         (apply string-append
                (map (lambda (n) (string-append n \", \")) names))))))

;; Helper: string-contains (simple substring check)
(define (string-contains str substr)
  (let ((str-len (string-length str))
        (sub-len (string-length substr)))
    (let loop ((i 0))
<|fim_suffix|>      (cond
        ((> (+ i sub-len) str-len) #f)
        ((string=? (substring str i (+ i sub-len)) substr) #t)
        (else (loop (+ i 1)))))))

;; Helper: take first n elements of list
(define (take lst n)
  (if (or (null? lst) (<= n 0))
      '()
      (cons (car lst) (take (cdr lst) (- n 1)))))

;; Helper: sort (simple insertion sort for clarity)
(define (sort lst less?)
  (if (null? lst)
      '()
      (insert (car lst) (sort (cdr lst) less?) less?)))

(define (insert x lst less?)
  (cond
    ((null? lst) (list x))
    ((less? x (car lst)) (cons x lst))
    (else (cons (car lst) (insert x (cdr lst) less?)))))

(define (search-product query)
  (let ((products-raw (cortex/recall \"products\" \"catalog\")))
    (if (or (eq? products-raw 'nan)
            (and (pair? products-raw) (eq? (car products-raw) 'escalate)))
        (list 'escalate \"catalog-unavailable\")
        (let ((products products-raw))
          ;; Try exact match
          (let ((exact (filter
                        (lambda (p)
                          (string=? (cdr (assoc 'name p)) query))
                        products)))
            (if (not (null? exact))
                (car exact)
<|fim_middle|>                ;; Try substring match
                (let ((substring-matches (filter
                                          (lambda (p)
                                            (string-contains (cdr (assoc 'name p)) query))
                                          products)))
                  (if (not (null? substring-matches))
                      (car substring-matches)
                      ;; Try keyword match (split query)
                      (let* ((keywords (string-split query #\\space))
                             (keyword-matches (filter
                                               (lambda (p)
                                                 (let ((name (cdr (assoc 'name p))))
                                                   (any (lambda (kw) (string-contains name kw))
                                                        keywords)))
<|fim_suffix|>                                               products)))
                        (if (not (null? keyword-matches))
                            (car keyword-matches)
                            (list 'escalate \"no-match\" query)))))))))))

;; Helper: any (returns #t if any element satisfies pred)
(define (any pred lst)
  (cond
    ((null? lst) #f)
    ((pred (car lst)) #t)

(define (find-top-restockable shop-id)
  ;; Stage 1: Fetch products
  (let ((products (printify/products shop-id)))
    (cond
      ((eq? products 'nan)
       (escalate \"fetch products failed\" shop-id))
      ((and (pair? products) (eq? (car products) 'escalate))
       products)

       ;; Stage 2: Map-transform to candidates

                                (let ((id (cdr (assoc \"id\" p)))
                                      (stock (cdr (assoc \"stock\" p)))
<|fim_middle|>                                      (sales (cdr (assoc \"sales_30d\" p))))
                                  (list id stock sales (/ sales (max stock 1)))))
                              products)))
         ;; Stage 3: Filter for low stock, high velocity
         (let ((filtered (filter (lambda (c)
                                   (let ((stock (cadr c))
                                         (velocity (cadddr c)))
                                     (and (< stock 10) (> velocity 2))))
                                 candidates)))
           (if (null? filtered)
               'nan
               ;; Stage 4: Fold to find highest velocity
               (let ((top (foldl (lambda (c best)
                                   (if (> (cadddr c) (cadddr best))
                                       c
<|fim_suffix|>                                       best))
                                 (car filtered)
                                 (cdr filtered))))
                 (let ((top-id (car top)))

                   (let ((detail (printify/product top-id)))
                     (cond
                       ((eq? detail 'nan)
                        (escalate \"fetch detail failed\" top-id))
                       ((and (pair? detail) (eq? (car detail) 'escalate))
                        detail)
                       (else
                        (cons 'restock-candidate detail)))))))))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Multi-stage pipeline with recursive retry logic: if any stage fails, retry up to limit.

(define (fetch-and-aggregate-with-retry shop-id attempts max-attempts)
  (if (>= attempts max-attempts)
      (escalate \"max retries exceeded\" shop-id)
      (let ((products (printify/products shop-id)))
        (cond
          ((eq? products 'nan)
           (fetch-and-aggregate-with-retry shop-id (+ attempts 1) max-attempts))
          ((and (pair? products) (eq? (car products) 'escalate))
<|fim_middle|>           (fetch-and-aggregate-with-retry shop-id (+ attempts 1) max-attempts))
          (else
           (let ((total (foldl (lambda (p acc)
                                 (let ((stock (cdr (assoc \"stock\" p))))
                                   (+ acc stock)))
                               0
                               products)))
             (let ((stats (etsy/shop-stats shop-id)))
               (cond
                 ((eq? stats 'nan)
<|fim_suffix|>                  (fetch-and-aggregate-with-retry shop-id (+ attempts 1) max-attempts))
                 ((and (pair? stats) (eq? (car stats) 'escalate))
                  (fetch-and-aggregate-with-retry shop-id (+ attempts 1) max-attempts))
                 (else
                  (list (cons \"total_stock\" total)
                        (cons \"revenue_30d\" (cdr (assoc \"revenue_30d\" stats)))))))))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Walk a nested catalog alist, call cortex/recall per category, printify/product per product, enrich in place.

(define (enrich-catalog catalog context)
  (cond
    ((null? catalog) '())
    ((not (pair? catalog)) catalog)
    ((and (pair? (car catalog)) (string? (caar catalog)))
     (let ((key (caar catalog))
           (value (cdar catalog)))
       (cond
         ((equal? key \"category\")
          (let ((note (cortex/recall context value)))
            (cons (car catalog)
                  (cons (cons \"category_note\" (if (eq? note 'nan) \"\" note))
                        (enrich-catalog (cdr catalog) context)))))
<|fim_middle|>         ((equal? key \"product_id\")
          (let ((detail (printify/product value)))
            (cons (car catalog)
                  (cons (cons \"product_detail\" (if (or (eq? detail 'nan)
                                                       (and (pair? detail) (eq? (car detail) 'escalate)))
                                                   '()
                                                   detail))
                        (enrich-catalog (cdr catalog) context)))))
         (else
          (cons (cons key (enrich-catalog value context))
                (enrich-catalog (cdr catalog) context))))))
    (else
     (cons (enrich-catalog (car catalog) context)
           (enrich-catalog (cdr catalog) context)))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Three-stage pipeline with fallback: if stage 2 fails, try alternate verb; preserve stage 1 result either way.

(define (fetch-with-fallback product-id)
  ;; Stage 1: Fetch product
  (let ((product (printify/product product-id)))
    (cond
      ((eq? product 'nan)
       (escalate \"product fetch failed\" product-id))
      ((and (pair? product) (eq? (car product) 'escalate))
       product)
      (else
<|fim_middle|>       (let ((stage1-result (cons \"product\" product)))
         ;; Stage 2: Fetch inventory (with fallback)
         (let ((inventory (stock/on-hand product-id)))
           (cond
             ((eq? inventory 'nan)
              ;; Fallback: try alternate verb
              (let ((alt-inventory (printify/product product-id))) ; pretend this is an alternate source
                (cond
                  ((eq? alt-inventory 'nan)
                   (list stage1-result (cons \"inventory\" 'fallback-failed)))
                  ((and (pair? alt-inventory) (eq? (car alt-inventory) 'escalate))
<|fim_suffix|>                   (list stage1-result (cons \"inventory\" 'fallback-failed)))
                  (else
                   (list stage1-result (cons \"inventory\" (cdr (assoc \"stock\" alt-inventory))))))))
             ((and (pair? inventory) (eq? (car inventory) 'escalate))
              (list stage1-result (cons \"inventory\" 'escalate)))
             (else
              ;; Stage 3: Combine results
              (list stage1-result (cons \"inventory\" inventory))))))))))

<|fim_prefix|>;; Fold with lookahead: reducer accesses current and next element to decide.

(define (detect-transitions events)
  (let loop ((remaining events) (acc '()))
    (if (null? remaining)
        (reverse acc)
        (let ((current (car remaining))
              (next (if (null? (cdr remaining))
                        '()
                        (cadr remaining))))
<|fim_middle|>          (let ((current-status (cdr (assoc \"status\" current)))
                (next-status (if (null? next)
                                 \"\"
                                 (cdr (assoc \"status\" next)))))
            (if (and (equal? current-status \"pending\")
                     (equal? next-status \"fulfilled\"))
                (loop (cdr remaining) (cons (cons \"transition\" current) acc))
                (loop (cdr remaining) acc)))))))

<|fim_prefix|>(define (make-cpu mem regs)
  (let ((pc     0)
        (z-flag #f)
        (n-flag #f)
        (halted #f))

    (define (fetch-byte)
      (let ((b (mem 'read pc)))
        (set! pc (+ pc 1))
        b))

    (define (set-flags result)
      ;; treat result as 8-bit; wrap into 0..255
      (let ((w (modulo result 256)))
        (set! z-flag (= w 0))
        (set! n-flag (>= w 128))
        w))

    (define (step)
      (if halted
          'halted
          (let ((op (fetch-byte)))
            (case op
<|fim_middle|>              ((0)   'nop)                                          ;; NOP
              ((1)                                                  ;; LDI r, imm
               (let ((r (fetch-byte)) (v (fetch-byte)))
                 (regs 'write r v)))
              ((2)                                                  ;; MOV rD, rS
               (let ((rd (fetch-byte)) (rs (fetch-byte)))
                 (regs 'write rd (regs 'read rs))))
              ((3)                                                  ;; ADD rD, rS
               (let* ((rd (fetch-byte)) (rs (fetch-byte))
                      (sum (+ (regs 'read rd) (regs 'read rs)))
                      (w (set-flags sum)))
                 (regs 'write rd w)))
              ((4)                                                  ;; SUB rD, rS
               (let* ((rd (fetch-byte)) (rs (fetch-byte))
                      (diff (- (regs 'read rd) (regs 'read rs)))
                      (w (set-flags diff)))
                 (regs 'write rd w)))
              ((5)                                                  ;; JMP addr
               (let ((a (fetch-byte)))
                 (set! pc a)))
              ((6)                                                  ;; JZ addr
               (let ((a (fetch-byte)))
                 (if z-flag (set! pc a))))
<|fim_suffix|>              ((7)                                                  ;; HALT
               (set! halted #t))
              (else (error 'unknown-opcode op))))))

    (define (run max-steps)
      (let loop ((n 0))
        (cond
          (halted 'halted)
          ((>= n max-steps) 'out-of-steps)
          (else
            (step)
            (loop (+ n 1))))))

    (lambda (msg . args)
      (cond
        ((eq? msg 'step)  (step))
        ((eq? msg 'run)   (run (car args)))
        ((eq? msg 'pc)    pc)
        ((eq? msg 'z)     z-flag)
        ((eq? msg 'n)     n-flag)
        ((eq? msg 'halted?) halted)
        ((eq? msg 'reset) (set! pc 0) (set! halted #f) 'reset)))))

(define cpu (make-cpu mem regs))

                (append (reverse numeric-args)
